concepts.way: misconception: ++i in the for-update runs before the body each pass
concepts.why: The update ++i runs only after each pass of the body, so i is 0, 1, 2 inside the body and the output is 0 1 2.

concepts.way: misconception: ++i in the for-update runs before the body each pass
concepts.why: In a for loop the order is init, test, body, then update, so the prefix form does not move the update before the body.
